messages:
alex_p: Heads-up — primary model (gen-xl-1) in eu-west-1 is hitting sustained slot saturation for tier=pro tenants. Thinking we should try an 'adaptive demotion -> edge reroute' instead of immediate demote. Avoids dropping latency-critical requests. Anyone object?

maria_l: Can you sketch the flow? Not sure what you mean by adaptive demotion vs current demote.

sam_r: Rough idea: when primary utilization > 90% for X seconds, start sampling/steering traffic to a compatible, lower-cost variant (e.g., gen-xl-1-int8 or gen-large-1) that has the same interface. Keep sticky routing for existing sessions so we don't hop mid-stream. We should also tag the request with a reason: "saturation".

cherie_c: Console/UX needs: surface a clear "overflowing" badge per-model + a per-tenant override to force or opt-out of automatic reroute. Ops should be able to toggle global test mode.

devon_s: Telemetry reqs: per-tenant fallback_rate, latency_delta, p50/p95 changes, errors from variant, and token_cost_delta. Also we need a histogram of how long the primary stayed saturated.

jules_k: Billing question — if we route to a cheaper variant, do we still bill at the primary rate for the tenant? product preference is transparent billing: charge for the actual variant used, but surface cost changes in the tenant bill. Need legal sign-off.

alex_p: Implementation constraints: keep API change minimal. My proposal: introduce a small routing flag on routes: `fallback_policy=adaptive_demote` (server-side only). It would accept parameters: sampling_window_s, utilization_threshold_pct, sticky_ttl_s, prefer_local_variant boolean. We'll avoid adding new client-visible knobs for now.

maria_l: Two operational concerns: 1) cold-start penalty for fallback variant pools -> we should warm a tiny pool on detection; 2) cross-region egress if fallback lives elsewhere. Warm pool + prefer_local_variant to avoid egress.

sam_r: Agree. Concrete pseudocode for router decision (simplified):
```
if primary.util_pct > threshold and primary.queue_len > q:
  for each incoming request:
    if sticky_cookie present and still valid -> route same as sticky
    else if sampling_pct hit -> route to best_compatible_variant(prefer_local=true) and set sticky_cookie(ttl)
    else -> attempt primary with short timeout and fallback to variant on failure
```
Keep fallback sampling default 100% only after we confirm warm pool; initially run at 1% for experiments.

cherie_c: Console hooks: add time-series metrics for `router.fallback_rate` and `router.fallback_reason{sat/quota/region}`. Also show a small alert suggestion panel: "Model gen-xl-1 is saturated. Consider scaling or enabling adaptive demotion."

devon_s: For tracing, add a span tag `route.decision_reason` and `route.variant_id`. We'll need dashboards that join by tenant_id to spot noisy tenants.

jules_k: UX for rollouts: can we do an A/B rollout at tenant level? e.g., opt-in a list of 10 tenants for 24h, collect quality metrics (latency, hallucination, error-rate) before we ramp.

alex_p: Yes — propose experiment: 10 tenants, 1% of their traffic -> fallback sampling at 100% for 24h. Capture quality evals on a prompt set. If no regressions, ramp to 25% then global.

maria_l: Edge case: what about pinned model versions? If tenant pinned to exact model hash, routing must respect pin and not fallback. Need a clear precedence: pinning > tenant opt-in > auto-demo.

sam_r: Also add a safety net: max_fallback_qps per-variant to avoid starving it. If fallback variant saturates, escalate to regional or tiered fallback or queue.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for `adaptive-demote` router scheduled: 2026-04-02T01:00:00Z. Canary config: 10 tenants, eu-west-1 only, sampling 1% -> then 100% for sampled traffic.

cherie_c: I'll add the two new graphs and an action button ("Force reroute for tenant") to the model page. Also add a short tooltip explaining billing implications.

devon_s: I'll add trace attributes and a prebuilt dashboard template for on-call. Need an alert threshold: >5% fallback_rate sustained for 5m => paged (S2).

jules_k: I'll draft the experiment email for tenant owners and internal comms. Also want product sign-off for billing change.

alex_p: Great. I'll open an RFC + small PR with router prototype and the console hooks. Link will follow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
